articles.title: Claude Haiku 5.5
articles.summary: As previously promised , here's Anthropic's new fast, low cost model: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5 . The previous Haiku, 4.5, was very much showing its age. It came out almost a year ago , and was priced at $1/million input and $5/million output - relatively expensive even back then, and a full 10x the price of OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna , released last month. The new Haiku exactly matches the price of GPT-6 Luna - $0.10/$0.50 - up to 100,000 tokens. Beyond 100,000 tokens the price increases 5x to $0.50/$2.50. Luna itself has a price increase at 272,000 tokens but only to $0.20/$0.75. Haiku 5.5...

articles.title: v8.0.0-rc.17-dev.5: Rename symbol in the PSL language server (#30633)
articles.summary: The PSL language server answers textDocument/rename and textDocument/prepareRename for models, composite types, named types, blocks (including enum blocks), fields and namespaces. A rename edits the declaration and every reference across the schema files of the project, from a cursor on the declaration name or on any reference. The renamed positions are exactly the ones find references ( #30621 ) returns. When the rename would change a database name, the edit also adds @map(" ") or @@map(" ") to the declaration, so the database keeps its names. Changes Rename provider (...

articles.summary: v8.0.0-rc.17 Migrations no longer lose data without being told to: prisma migration plan and prisma db update ask about each model or field a plan would drop, answered with --delete or with the new --rename , which keeps the rows. The ORM client gains row locks, apply and scope are renamed to with and fragment , and db.enums holds each member as a query returns it.
